items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds 'I kind of had to.'

ctx.x: Janis was interviewed in Clinton, New York on May 22, 2015 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Janis Siegel here. Thanks for coming.
